name: io.github.nick353/jp-bank-code
title: Japan Bank Code
description: Japanese bank/branch codes with kana, transfer pre-checks, Japan Post Bank conversion. No API key.

tools.name: lookup_bank
tools.description: Find a Japanese financial institution by 4-digit bank code (金融機関コード) or by name in kanji, kana (full or half width) or romaji. Covers banks, shinkin, credit unions, JA and more.

query.description: Bank code or name, e.g. 0001, みずほ, ﾐｽﾞﾎ, mizuho

tools.name: lookup_branch
tools.description: Find a branch of a Japanese bank by 3-digit branch code (支店コード) or by branch name / kana.

bank.description: 4-digit bank code or exact bank name

query.description: Branch code or name, e.g. 001, 東京営業部, ｼﾌﾞﾔ

tools.name: verify_bank_branch
tools.description: Before a domestic bank transfer, check that a bank code + branch code pair exists and return the official names and kana (as used in zengin transfer files).

tools.name: yucho_to_transfer
tools.description: Convert a Japan Post Bank (ゆうちょ銀行) 記号・番号 into the branch name, branch code, account type and account number needed to receive transfers from other banks, using the official rule (e.g. 11940-12345671 -> 198 一九八店 普通 1234567). Nothing is stored.
